title: Concept: Pre-release versions are accepted by the resolver
description: Pipfile declares a Pipfile that allows pre-releases, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Pipfile that allows pre-releases.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a Pipfile that allows pre-releases.
